name: Suspicious Thick-Cut Duelist's Burger
desc: A burger with a thick-cut steak as its main ingredient. The steak has been cut too thick and grilled too dry. It feels like you're chewing on some strange, rubbery meat, and the lettuce seems to have been left out for too long and wilted... Ingredients that should have complemented each other are now clashing on the tip of your tongue...

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 224 and CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
